proposal.summary: Incorrect permission assignment in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3 allows a local user of the PC where the product is installed to gain wide privileges, potentially destroy the system or execute a malicious program.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: ACL (Access Control List) is not appropriately set to the local folder where the affected product is installed

AV.quote: a user of the PC where the affected product is installed

I.quote: the user may be able to destroy the system and/or execute a malicious program

proposal.recommended_next_step: Instruct customers to update to CHS 3.5.3; audit and correct the ACLs on the installation directory to restrict write/execute permissions to administrators only; provide a patch or installer that enforces secure permissions.
